cite.quote: in the Normandy landings on 6 June 1944

summary.text: The central of the five D-Day landing beaches, between Port-en-Bessin and La Rivière (Ver-sur-Mer). Because of cliffs at its western end, the landings were made on the flatter Jig and King sectors between Le Hamel and La Rivière. It was assaulted by the British 50th (Northumbrian) Infantry Division of XXX Corps. Its objectives were to take Arromanches, Bayeux and Port-en-Bessin, make contact with US forces at Omaha and link with the Canadians at Juno.
